description: Retrieval evaluation set for the sample FDA label. A retrieved chunk counts as relevant if its text (lower-cased, whitespace collapsed) contains any 'gold' phrase. Questions are phrased as a user would ask, not copied from the label. Gold phrases were widened once, after inspecting results, for two questions whose correct patient-information wording the original phrase missed (storage, alcohol); all variants were re-scored with the same set.
